obligations.description: - `Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md` still collides with `Contracts_V0.md` on what “envelope” means, still requires missing schema files, still omits `attempt_id` from the common identity set, and still does not pin whether artifact attribution comes from embedded runtime snapshots or mandatory attempt joins.
exact_items: - `Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md` still collides with `Contracts_V0.md` on what “envelope” means, still requires missing schema files, still omits `attempt_id` from the common identity set, and still does not pin whether artifact attribution comes from embedded runtime snapshots or mandatory attempt joins.
